name: The Face of Boe
oracle_text: {T}: You may cast a spell with suspend from your hand. If you do, pay its suspend cost rather than its mana cost. Activate only as a sorcery.
blocked_sentences: {T}: You may cast a spell with suspend from your hand. If you do, pay its suspend cost rather than its mana cost. Activate only as a sorcery.

needs.what: an effect that lets the controller cast a card from their hand that has suspend, paying that card's printed suspend cost (its `suspend` mana) as an alternative cost instead of its mana cost, cast immediately rather than exiled with time counters; plus a selector key matching cards that have suspend
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cast_from_hand` and `cast_card` take only as/exiles/objects/per_owner/player/selector/zones and have no option to substitute the card's suspend cost for its mana cost; the `suspend` op exiles a card with time counters instead of casting it; and `selector_keys` has nothing that matches a card by having suspend (keywords lists no suspend, and suspend is a card-level cost key)
